instruction: I want to disable automatic subtitle loading in VLC. Currently VLC automatically loads subtitle files if they're in the same folder as the video, but I don't want this behavior. How can I turn off automatic subtitle detection?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
